title: Concurrent Parameter Learning and Current Control for Large-scale Grid-following Inverter-based Resources
summary: The integration of large-scale inverter-based resources (IBRs) into the grid presents two key challenges in terms of optimal power generation and transmission system stability. This work proposes concurrent transmission parameter learning and optimal power generation and current control for the grid-following IBRs. The proposed approach estimates transmission parameters online using the current measurements, enabling the IBRs to adapt their control actions to evolving grid conditions.
